queries: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rental_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_rental_price_per_day, avg_rental_price_per_day / AVG(avg_rental_price_per_day) OVER () AS ratio_to_rating_average FROM rating_averages ORDER BY rating

assumptions.assumption: Each film contributes equally to its rating’s average; its rental price per day is rental_rate divided by rental_duration.

alternatives.interpretation: Divide the total listed rental prices by the total listed rental days within each rating, so films with longer rental durations carry more weight.

assumptions.assumption: A film’s price per day is its rental_rate divided by its listed rental_duration; the rating average is the average of those film-level prices.

alternatives.interpretation: Divide each rating’s average rental rate by its average rental duration, then compare those rating-level figures equally.
